decisions.reason: The source-collection change does not alter the moment-selection standard; the candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY for the independently stated substantive-moment and ongoing-production changes.

Changing the permitted source collection and removing the trial batch constraint does not alter narrative completeness; the candidate already records the same message's standalone-completeness instruction.
The source-selection change does not itself affect clip duration, and the candidate already records the independently stated 70-85 second rule from the same message.
The source message does not change or reaffirm the good-hook criterion, and the source-collection change does not logically modify it.
Selecting Arden Vale's long-form videos and dropping the one-video trial constraint does not entail any change to clean visual-editing rules or their scope.

The removed batch_source_constraint belonged to source selection for the earlier eight-clip trial and is absent from this candidate's current state; the deferred one-clip assignment is not necessarily changed by the source decision.
The source-collection change does not alter the monthly quota or approval rules; the candidate already records the same message's independent daily-output clarification.
The permitted source collection and trial batch constraint do not affect caption color or text-effect requirements.
The message reiterates that an Instagram account will be assigned but does not change the candidate's existing account type, provisioning method, or purpose.
Mentioning performance bonuses does not change the existing posted-clip tracking metrics, applicability, or transparency, and the source-selection decision has no necessary effect on them.
The source-selection change does not modify the brand-compliant caption-font standard.
